title: Leaderboard — signal and staking kept apart

rule.why: ROI is signal x staking x price. A generous staking run on a coin-flip signal produces a hot ROI that means nothing, so staking columns are reported in their own group and are structurally excluded from rank: no staking value can raise or lower a signal_rank. A strategy ranks only on signal_n, signal_z and signal_p measured against its registered baseline.
rule.demotion: G8 (data/gates.json): a live strategy whose signal decays goes back to paper
rule.reward_note: rewards are paid on gate-passing signal, never on a staking streak
